facts.fact: Construction of Phase 2 of the National Fibre Optic Backbone Infrastructure Project, a 721.5 km fibre network covering 15 major cities in the northern, eastern and southern regions, had commenced by September 2020 under a Huawei contract signed 11 April 2019 and financed by a China Eximbank RMB 207 million loan (AidData record).
